spans.s: सुख (I) a. (f. खा) 1. Happy, joyful, delighted; 2. agreeable, sweet, comfortable, दिशः प्रसेदुर्मरुतो ववुः सुखाः R.iii.14; 3. virtuous, pious; 4. easy, practicable; 5. meet, suitable.

सुख (II) n. 1. Happiness, pleasure, delight, joy, comfort, सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते Mrich.i.; 2. prosperity, सुखे वा दुःखे वा क्व नु खलु तदैक्यं हृदययोः Ut.vi.; 3. ease, alleviation; 4. easiness; 5. heaven, paradise; 6. water.(सुखा f. ‘the city of Varuṇa.’)(सुखम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) happily, joyfully, well, e.g. सुखमास्तं भवान् ‘may your honour be well’; (2) willingly, rather; (3) comfortably, सुखं शेते मातस्तव खलु कृपातः पुनरयं जगन्नाथः G.
; (4) easily, अज्ञः सुखमाराध्यः सुखतरमाराध्यते विषेषज्ञः Bhartr.ii.3, Bg.v.3.)
सुख (I) a. (f. खा) 1. Happy, joyful, delighted; 2. agreeable, sweet, comfortable, दिशः प्रसेदुर्मरुतो ववुः सुखाः R.iii.14; 3. virtuous, pious; 4. easy, practicable; 5. meet, suitable.
सुख-आधार m. paradise.
सुख-आप्लव a. convenient for bathing.
सुख-आयात, -आयन m. a well-trained horse.
सुख-आयात, -आयन m. a well-trained horse.
सुख-आरोह a. of easy ascent.
सुख-आलोक a. pleasant-looking, charming.
सुख-आवह a. bringing happiness.
सुख-आश m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
सुख-आशक m. a cucumber.
सुख-आस्वाद (I) a. 1. pleasantly flavoured; 2. delightful, agreeable.
सुख-आस्वाद (II) m. 1. a pleasant flavour; 2. enjoyment.
सुख-उत्सव m. 1. a pleasure-festival, merry-making, jubilee; 2. a husband.
सुख-उदक n. warm water.
सुख-उदय m. realization of pleasure.
सुख-उदर्क a. resulting in happiness or pleasure.
सुख-उद्य a. to be uttered agreeably.
सुख-उपविष्ट a. seated at ease, प्रासादपृष्ठे सुखोपविष्टानां राजपुत्राणां पुरस्तात् Hit.i.
सुख-द (I) a. affording pleasure.
सुख-द (II) n. the seat of Viṣṇu.
सुख-दा f. a courtezan of Indra’s heaven.
